svg.text: MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Section A-A through body axis; spout side to the right.
2. Water path wetted parts: 316/316L stainless or borosilicate 3.3 only.
3. Prototype joints: twin-ferrule compression; production: brazed (Ag-free, food-safe).
4. Torque compression nuts 1¼ turns from finger-tight; leak test 20 kPa, 10 min.
PD trigger, 20 V 60 W heater, KSD301, TCO
Total dry mass ≈ 2.73 kg (incl. fittings, seals, insulation, spout, dial ≈ 260 g). * glassblower to order.
Note: this supersedes the ~1.3 kg on the v0.5 concept sheet; the heat-exchanger tubes and shell dominate.
Jug 15 → pump 19 → exchanger 5, outer tube, upward (25 → ~95 °C)
→ mini-tube heater 9 on block 8 (→ ~100 °C) → boil coil 10 (~60 mL, ~3 min boiling)
vent standpipe 11: steam + CO₂ out; overflow back to jug during warm-up
→ drawer 12: catcher 13 (25 µm) → wax gate 14 (opens ≥ 92–95 °C) → riser
→ exchanger 5, inner tube, downward (→ ~29 °C) → body coil 4 on shell 3 (→ ~27 °C) → spout 17
